contract_name: FRD_Medicare Expansion-MIDS - Socially Determined feed-level mapping contract

project.business_context_summary: Socially Determined’s benefit is to provide access to their social risk intelligence database that computes individual member risk scores in a geographic region. The Risks data is required in the Lakehouse for Analytical Reporting.

in_scope: Transfer of MI Risk files (Community Demographic, Community Risk & Individual Risk) from Socially Determined to Lakehouse .
This covers the field mappings, data types, constraints, and transformation rules required to migrate risk data into Lakehouse .
Ensuring data accuracy and integrity through rigorous testing and validation procedures.
Seamless integration with existing systems and processes.
Inclusion of requested Line of Business (LOBs) in the scope.
Below are the file name & description of this file data ingestion.
out_of_scope: Any transformation or restricting of data beyond what is required for migration is not included.
Enhancements to data quality or data cleansing beyond the accuracy required for migration are not included.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Accessibility
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: All necessary data needed for Risk report as part of this FRD are accessible to the reporting team

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Format Compatibility
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The data from the various sources can be transformed into a format compatible with Lakehouse

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Consistent Data Sources
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Data sources will remain consistent and accessible.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: QA testing scope
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The QA will be testing the Data validation between the QA source tables and target tables and the ADF orchestration for this requirement completely.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Dictionary and Data Quality Rules
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: There will not be any transformation of data involved, and the data quality rules are available in the mapping document. Please refer the appendix section.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Governance
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Data transformation rules must comply with existing data governance policies.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Source Availability
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The availability and reliability of data sources are critical. Any changes or downtime in these sources can impact the automation process.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Database Access
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Timely access to required databases and servers.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: UAT signoff
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The Analytics team is expected to provide UAT signoff on the test results shared by QA team on QA data for the requirement to be productionized as per the change management process into DL 2.0  Frank,Laranko will approve the QA results and provide UAT Signoff.
